name: What is the typical cost to install a fold-down shower seat?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to install a fold-down shower seat?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of installing a fold-down shower seat can vary based on the seat's material, design, and complexity of the installation. Professional installation typically ranges from $200 to $600, not including the cost of the seat itself, which can range from $100 to $500 or more. Factors influencing the price include whether wall reinforcement is needed, the type of wall material, and labor rates in the Bay Area. For an accurate estimate, it's best to get a detailed quote after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation costs typically range from $200 to $600, plus the seat's cost ($100-$500+). Prices vary based on seat type, wall reinforcement needs, and local labor rates in the Bay Area.
